description: Diagnoses why permission_scope, temporal_stability, and tool_description_safety signals show only 3 distinct values each (range: 30-100, 40-90, 50-100). Reads metadata field coverage in the three enrichment modules. Checks if compute_score() reads sufficient fields per enrichment contract. Pure diagnostic, no DB writes, no network. Targets enrichment modules built 2026-05-03, not protected signal_analyser.py.
